set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/mvpa-dataset. Acceptance: distinguish labeled and unlabeled MVPA dataset views so classifier workflows can require labels; introduce typed SampleMetadata with aligned columns for class labels, blocks, runs, and items; make SampleOrigin cases private or typed by timepoint/row/estimate ids; add voxel-backed vs abstract feature mapping; tie DataSelection and metadata into one typed dataset pattern request; structure MvpaDatasetError categories. Verification: mvpaDatasetJVM/test and mvpaDatasetJS/test plus dataset/mvpa compile fallout.
set.title: Type MVPA dataset labels, metadata, origins, and feature mappings
